name: Tool Removal
query:
SELECT
    TR.name AS "Document No:Link/Tool Removal:150",
    TR.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    TR.branch AS "Branch:120",
    TR.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    TR.customer_name AS "Customer Name:200",
    TR.tool_installation AS "Installation:150",
    TR.tool_issue AS "Issue:150",
    TR.cpc_component AS "Component:150",
    TR.machine AS "Machine:150",
    TR.operation AS "Operation:150",
    TR.tool_type AS "Tool Type:120",
    TR.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:150",
    TR.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool:150",
    TR.planned_tool_life AS "Planned Tool Life:120",
    TR.actual_tool_life AS "Actual Tool Life:120",
    TR.starting_production_counter AS "Start Production Counter:150",
    TR.ending_production_counter AS "End Production Counter:150",
    TR.removal_reason AS "Removal Reason:200",
    TC.condition_name AS "Condition:150",
    TR.tool_life_status AS "Status:120"

FROM `tabTMS Tool Removal` TR

LEFT JOIN `tabTMS Tool Condition` TC
    ON TC.name = TR.current_condition

WHERE TR.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
